oct01-synthid-fig1.alt: Original SynthID Bio Figure 1: sequence generation and detection above, and watermarking of predicted AlphaFold 3 coordinates below
oct01-synthid-fig1.kind: Original Figure 1 · two different watermarking workflows
oct01-synthid-fig1.caption: Panel a shows selection of ProteinMPNN sequence designs. Panel b is a separate method that marks predicted AF3 coordinates. A digital structure watermark is not a physical label attached to a synthesized protein.
oct01-synthid-fig1.changes: Original complete PNG retained; no panels, axes, colors or annotations changed. Caption translated into English.

oct01-synthid-fig2.alt: Original SynthID Bio Figure 2: binding affinity and hit rates for three targets, sequence scores, a predicted binder and backbone-specific detectability
oct01-synthid-fig2.kind: Original Figure 2 · binding experiments and predicted structure
oct01-synthid-fig2.caption: Panels a and b contain laboratory binding results, c and e sequence scores, and d a predicted binder structure. The original panels and colors are unchanged; a prediction visualization is not a microscopy image.
oct01-synthid-fig2.changes: Original complete PNG retained; no panels, axes, colors or annotations changed. Caption translated into English.

oct01-bcn-wafer-photo.alt: Background photograph of repeated circuits on an ordinary silicon wafer; this is not the BCN wafer investigated in the paper
oct01-bcn-wafer-photo.kind: Background photograph · not the experimental BCN wafer
oct01-bcn-wafer-photo.caption: This separate silicon-wafer photograph illustrates repeated fabrication over a substrate. It is not evidence of the BCN study's growth process, device yield or measured performance.
oct01-bcn-wafer-photo.changes: Existing 1280-pixel Wikimedia Commons rendition retained without cropping or recoloring. English caption preserves the background-only label.

oct01-bcn-primer.alt: Educational BCN diagram with English labels: conceptual carbon substitution and the source, drain, gate and monolayer channel
oct01-bcn-primer.kind: Author-created educational diagram · not measured structure
oct01-bcn-primer.caption: A simplified explanation of carbon substitution and a p-type current channel. It does not reproduce the paper's atomic images, actual carbon distribution, dielectric thickness, device cross-section or measurements.
oct01-bcn-primer.changes: English translation of the author's existing SVG labels and accessibility text; geometry and colors retained. One label font size adjusted to fit. No publisher figure was copied.

oct01-ataraxos-fig2.alt: Original Ataraxos Figure 2: a Stratego board viewed from the red side with opposing blue identities concealed, followed by a battle example
oct01-ataraxos-fig2.caption: Panel a is a starting board from the red player's perspective; b illustrates a battle. This is not a photograph of the 20-game evaluation or a ground-truth map of its hidden pieces.
oct01-ataraxos-fig2.changes: Original complete PNG retained; no panels, axes, colors or annotations changed. Caption translated into English.

oct01-ataraxos-fig3.alt: Original Ataraxos Figure 3: actual outcomes of 20 games and the value network's changing forecasts as each game progresses
oct01-ataraxos-fig3.kind: Original Figure 3 · observed outcomes and model estimates
oct01-ataraxos-fig3.caption: WIN, LOSS and DRAW identify actual outcomes. The plotted lines represent the model's estimates during individual games, not the observed win frequency across all 20 games.
oct01-ataraxos-fig3.changes: Original complete PNG retained; no panels, axes, colors or annotations changed. Caption translated into English.
